# temps_deployment_token (Resource)

A project token that apps and CI use to call Temps (for example to send email or read analytics).

Temps returns the token value only when it is created, so it is kept in state as a sensitive value: protect the state file. An imported token has no `token` value; replace it to mint a new one.

Import with `<project_id>/<token_id>`.

Required API key permissions: `deployment_tokens:read`, `deployment_tokens:create`, `deployment_tokens:write`, `deployment_tokens:delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_deployment_token" "mailer" {
  project_id  = temps_project.web.id
  name        = "mailer"
  permissions = ["emails:send"]
  expires_at  = "2030-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}

# Hand the token to the app as a secret variable.
resource "temps_environment_variable" "mailer_token" {
  project_id      = temps_project.web.id
  key             = "TEMPS_DEPLOYMENT_TOKEN"
  value           = temps_deployment_token.mailer.token
  environment_ids = [data.temps_environment.production.id]
  is_secret       = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name, unique within the project.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) `false` deactivates the token without deleting it. Defaults to `true`.
- `environment_id` (Number) Restrict the token to one environment of `project_id`. Omit it for every environment.
- `expires_at` (String) RFC 3339 time after which the token stops working, for example `2030-01-01T00:00:00Z`. Must be in the future when created. The API cannot remove an expiry, so removing it replaces the token.
- `permissions` (Set of String) What the token may do, for example `emails:send` or `analytics:read`; `*` grants full access. Omit it for full access.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric token ID.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The token value, known only to the run that created it.
- `token_prefix` (String) First characters of the token, to recognise it in logs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import temps_deployment_token.mailer 3/8
```
